causal_state.balance_sheet_stress: transfer_notional divided by prior-only rolling median absolute 5-minute OI-notional change
causal_state.entry: first observed last_price within one second after T+10m or T+15m
causal_state.exit: first observed last_price within one second after entry boundary plus 15/30/60/120 minutes
causal_state.funding_finalization: first row carrying funding_timestamp T and final funding_rate whose local_timestamp is in [T,T+5m]
causal_state.global_slot: one accepted position across all eligible symbols; score then symbol tie break; no entry at or before prior exit
causal_state.post_state: one or two completed five-minute bars after settlement
causal_state.pre_state: completed [T-60m,T) price and OI state with 48-bar prior-only scales

data_contract.symbol_eligibility: at least 10 source dates and 18 complete non-midnight settlements in each partition; source completeness only

families.payer_closure_cascade: large transfer, post OI contraction and payer-direction displacement; trade payer-flush direction
families.prepaid_deleverage_reversal: pre OI contraction and payer-direction move, post OI stall, extension and >=50% reclaim; trade opposite payer flush
families.receiver_releverage_impulse: large transfer, post OI expansion and receiver-direction displacement; trade the same directional side as payer flush

non_overlap: PR #74 instantaneous OI times aggressive flow
objective: Test whether actual funding-transfer notional and the exact-settlement OI balance-sheet reaction create a repeatable after-cost liquidity run or completed-sweep reversal.
prohibitions: No symbol selection from returns or candidate performance.
No final funding value, OI or price before local arrival.
No same-boundary or favorable OHLC fill.
No family, metric, threshold, cost, gate or fallback change after outcomes.
No ranking promotion from this sparse proxy.

smc_ict_translation.displacement: post-settlement price movement aligned with OI closure or creation
smc_ict_translation.invalidation: opposing reclaim/OI-state reversal for continuation or renewed payer contraction/loss of reclaim for reversal
smc_ict_translation.liquidity_pool: payer or receiver inventory defined by the funding sign
smc_ict_translation.liquidity_pressure: abs(final settled funding rate) multiplied by causally available open interest and mark price
smc_ict_translation.liquidity_run: payer closure cascade or receiver re-leveraging impulse
smc_ict_translation.survivor_execution: first causal displacement-imbalance/FVG retracement at exact BBO and depth
smc_ict_translation.sweep_exhaustion: prepaid OI contraction, extreme extension, stalled post OI contraction and at least half-range reclaim

survivor_action: Keep 2024 sealed; expand remaining pre-2024 continuous data, exact BBO/depth, first-imbalance entry, actual hold funding, structural exits, risk sizing and continuous NAV.
zero_survivor_action: Retire the exact cash-notional by OI-reaction dependency without adjacent tuning.
